identification: John Campbell Pottery (Launceston, Tasmania) large twin-handled bulbous vase, flared neck, two loop handles, streaked brown/caramel/cream/oxblood drip glaze, H 25 cm. Base incised 'A308 LH' (shape/glaze code and decorator or thrower initials) over 'John Campbell 1933' in the usual Campbell script. One handle repaired per catalogue (photo 4 is a close-up of one handle; a pale patch at the upper handle join is likely the repair). Lot page: estimate A$150-250, current bid A$70.
